title: Isolate MemoryChangePublisher subscriber failures
description:
P1 finding from 10-agent swarm codebase audit (P1-018). MemoryChangePublisher.PublishAsync uses Task.WhenAll on subscriber tasks. Any subscriber exception propagates up through AuditAndPublishAsync to CreateAsync/UpdateAsync/DeleteAsync, blocking memory mutations. Wrap subscriber invocations in try/catch that logs and swallows.

File: MemorySmith.App/Services/MemoryChangePublisher.cs (lines 43-49)
Confidence: 90%
Source: codebase-audit-20260710-agent10-swarm-v2.md
